boundary.validInputs: Use the established source-real corpse-upper seed-55 setup for direct C/JS parity and the user-authorized constructed doapply() fixture for the unavailable statue-upper polarity. Record the constructed state, controlling source, setup-route limitation, integration evidence, and what the substitute cannot prove.
boundary.observables: Exact selected-object message, ECMD_OK on the first listen and the next input boundary, zero branch PRNG calls, full terminal attributes and cursor, pile and timer preservation, and no refusal or effect from an exceptional unselected lower object.

sourceReview: The completed goal-wide trace remains recorded above. Commit 0208e71 closes apply.c:203-220's mixed-pile selection: sobj_at() finds the first corpse and statue, nxtobj(statue, CORPSE, TRUE) determines which occurs later in the nexthere chain, and exactly one existing downstream arm owns the result. Preflight and execution share selectedDeadObject(), including one cached can_reach_floor(TRUE) result in source order. Seed 55 proves the player-reachable corpse-upper polarity against C. Direct statue wishes remain refused and no ported command places a statue above a corpse, so the user's 2026-08-19 authorization supplies the reverse polarity through a documented live doapply() integration fixture; that substitute does not prove player-input reachability or direct C parity for the unavailable arrangement. Hallucination, selected REVIVE_MON, selected filled Healer statues, out-of-reach tiny statues, and fog-region movement remain separate later entries.
